raw_response:
This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the negative log probability across various per-specialty terms for different language models. The horizontal axis contains the categories, labeled "Per-specialty terms," ordered from left to right as Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics. The vertical value axis is labeled "Negative log probability" and features a linear scale ranging from -22 at the top to -27 at the bottom, with numeric tick labels at intervals of 1. The bars originate at the -22 baseline and extend downwards. Within each of the six horizontal categories, there is a group of seven bars. According to the legends at the top, the leftmost bar in each group is colored light blue and represents "Mistralv0.2-Base." The subsequent six bars in each group represent models "Fine-tuned on:" specific specialties, colored in a gradient from light beige to dark brown corresponding to Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics, respectively. Across all groups, the light blue Mistralv0.2-Base bar extends the furthest downwards, with the longest overall bar appearing in the Cardio category at approximately -26.8. The shortest bars appear in the Infect category group, extending downwards to approximately -23.0 to -23.2. The bars within each group are not sorted by length, but rather follow the consistent categorical order defined in the legend, and no specific bars are visually emphasized beyond their assigned legend colors.
